description: entity-researcher must render the time-window heading it was given, must not compare against siblings when posture is one-of-a-parallel-set, and must catch a funding round that is fabricated by SEO aggregators.
ground_truth: As of 2026-08, at least one lead-generation aggregator (salestools.io) publishes a Linear 'Series D, $50M at $650M valuation' dated October 2025. It is fabricated: it is priced BELOW the well-documented $82M Series C at $1.25B post led by Accel in June 2025, and no credible source (Crunchbase, PitchBook, Tracxn, TechCrunch, Reuters) carries it. Two independent researcher instances caught this on 2026-08-06 and 2026-08-07.
